# NEW 2026-11-23 v21.0 Module E2: 6 Mid/Late-Game Imperial Disasters (Expanding Custom Disasters 8 -> 14) (oe_dis2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v210_disasters_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Disaster 1: Imperial Overextension & Sovereign Default (Age 2+, 1400+)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
oe_dis2_imperial_overextension = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/decline_of_empire.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
		current_year >= 1400
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_overext_cd }
		country_rank_level >= 3
		num_locations >= 120
		OR = {
			num_loans >= 6
			is_during_bankruptcy = yes
			AND = {
				war_exhaustion >= 8
				stability < 20
			}
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			num_locations < 80
			AND = {
				is_during_bankruptcy = no
				num_loans <= 2
				war_exhaustion < 4
				stability >= 20
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_overext_steps }
					var:oe_dis2_overext_steps >= 2
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_overext_months }
				var:oe_dis2_overext_months >= 144
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		tax_income_efficiency = -0.18
		bank_interest = 0.03
		monthly_inflation = 0.0012
		global_monthly_control = -0.004
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.005
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.20
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_overext_steps value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_overext_months value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.1
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			5 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			95 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_overext_months }
				change_variable = { name = oe_dis2_overext_months add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_overext_months value = 1 }
			}
			random_list = {
				95 = { }
				3 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_2_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.2
				}
				2 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_22_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.22
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_overext_months }
			remove_variable = oe_dis2_overext_months
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_overext_cd value = 1 years = 30 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.3
	}
}

# Disaster 2: Praetorian & Gunpowder-Transition Mutiny (Age 3+, 1460+)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
oe_dis2_military_transition_mutiny = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/coup_attempt.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		current_year >= 1460
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_mutiny_cd }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_modern_corps_settlement }
		num_locations >= 35
		OR = {
			army_size >= 40
			regular_army_size >= 20
		}
		OR = {
			has_embraced_institution = institution:pike_and_shot
			has_embraced_institution = institution:artillery_institution
			has_embraced_institution = institution:military_revolution
		}
		OR = {
			stability < 15
			war_exhaustion >= 6
			AND = {
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				legitimacy < 55
			}
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_modern_corps_settlement
			AND = {
				stability >= 25
				war_exhaustion < 4
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_mutiny_steps }
					var:oe_dis2_mutiny_steps >= 2
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_mutiny_months }
				var:oe_dis2_mutiny_months >= 120
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		discipline = -0.05
		land_morale_modifier = -0.10
		army_maintenance_efficiency = -0.25
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.005
		regiment_recruit_speed = -0.25
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.08
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_mutiny_steps value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_mutiny_months value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.4
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			5 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			95 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_mutiny_months }
				change_variable = { name = oe_dis2_mutiny_months add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_mutiny_months value = 1 }
			}
			random_list = {
				95 = { }
				3 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_5_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.5
				}
				2 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_22_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.22
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_mutiny_months }
			remove_variable = oe_dis2_mutiny_months
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_mutiny_cd value = 1 years = 35 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.6
	}
}

# Disaster 3: Transoceanic Colonial Independence Wave (Strictly Age 5-6, 1640+)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
oe_dis2_colonial_independence_wave = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/aspiration_for_liberty.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
		current_year >= 1640
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_colonial_cd }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_imperial_federation }
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_colonial_overlord = yes
				any_subject = {
					count >= 3
					is_subject_type = colonial_nation
				}
			}
			any_owned_location = {
				count >= 15
				is_overseas_for_owner = yes
			}
		}
		OR = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = colonial_nation
				liberty_desire >= 45
			}
			any_subject = {
				subject_loyalty < 45
			}
			stability < 20
			war_exhaustion >= 5
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_imperial_federation
			AND = {
				is_colonial_overlord = no
				NOT = {
					any_owned_location = {
						count >= 10
						is_overseas_for_owner = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				stability >= 25
				NOT = {
					any_subject = {
						is_subject_type = colonial_nation
						liberty_desire >= 50
					}
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_colonial_steps }
					var:oe_dis2_colonial_steps >= 2
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_colonial_months }
				var:oe_dis2_colonial_months >= 144
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		subject_loyalty = -15
		subject_income_modifier = -0.30
		trade_sea_efficiency = -0.15
		navy_maintenance_efficiency = -0.20
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.004
		global_maritime_presence_modifier = -0.15
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_colonial_steps value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_colonial_months value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.7
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			5 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			95 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_colonial_months }
				change_variable = { name = oe_dis2_colonial_months add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_colonial_months value = 1 }
			}
			random_list = {
				95 = { }
				3 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_8_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.8
				}
				2 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_23_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.23

		}

oe_dis2_court_regency_crisis = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/succession_crisis.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
		current_year >= 1400
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_regency_cd }
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		num_locations >= 40
		OR = {
			has_regent = yes
			legitimacy < 40
		}
		OR = {
			stability < 25
			legitimacy < 45
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { government_type = government_type:monarchy }
			AND = {
				has_regent = no
				legitimacy >= 65
				stability >= 20
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_regency_steps }
					var:oe_dis2_regency_steps >= 2
				}

				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_regency_months }

# Disaster 5: Early Industrial Labor & Enclosure Unrest (Strictly Age 5-6, 1660+)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
oe_dis2_industrial_labor_unrest = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/ciompi_revolt.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
		current_year >= 1660
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_labor_cd }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_factory_labor_compact }
		num_locations >= 30
		OR = {
			has_embraced_institution = institution:manufactories
			has_embraced_institution = institution:industrialization
		}
		OR = {
			stability < 25
			inflation >= 0.06
			war_exhaustion >= 4
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_factory_labor_compact
			AND = {
				stability >= 25
				inflation < 0.05
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_labor_steps }
					var:oe_dis2_labor_steps >= 2
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_labor_months }
				var:oe_dis2_labor_months >= 120
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		global_production_efficiency = -0.20
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.12
		burghers_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.08
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.006
		global_monthly_prosperity = -0.005
		global_raw_material_output = -0.10
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_labor_steps value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_labor_months value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.13
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			5 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			95 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_labor_months }
				change_variable = { name = oe_dis2_labor_months add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_labor_months value = 1 }
			}
			random_list = {
				95 = { }
				3 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_14_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.14
				}
				2 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_24_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.24

	on_end = {

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Disaster 6: Multi-Confessional Schism Backlash (Age 3-5, 1480+)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
oe_dis2_confessional_schism_backlash = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/religious_turmoil.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		OR = {
			current_age = age_3_discovery
			current_age = age_4_reformation
			current_age = age_5_absolutism
		}
		current_year >= 1480
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_schism_cd }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_ecumenical_toleration_edict }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_confessional_uniformity }
		num_locations >= 50
		religious_unity < 0.65
		stability < 25
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_ecumenical_toleration_edict
			has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_confessional_uniformity
			AND = {
				stability >= 20
				OR = {
					religious_unity >= 0.78
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_schism_steps }
						var:oe_dis2_schism_steps >= 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_schism_months }
				var:oe_dis2_schism_months >= 120
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		clergy_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.12
		global_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.06
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.006
		monthly_religious_influence = -0.15
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.20
		global_monthly_control = -0.003
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_schism_steps value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_schism_months value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.16
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			5 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			95 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_schism_months }
				change_variable = { name = oe_dis2_schism_months add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_schism_months value = 1 }
			}
			random_list = {
				95 = { }
				3 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_17_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.17
				}
				2 = {
					trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_24_cd } }
					trigger_event_silently = oe_dis2.24
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_schism_months }
			remove_variable = oe_dis2_schism_months
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_schism_cd value = 1 years = 35 }
